title: Advance Payment on a Booked Respite and Short-Term Stay
content:
Before a booked stay begins, the guest or a financial representative pays the advance on the stay in one payment. This is the advance of the Respite and Short-Term Stay Agreement.

## Rule

The advance is fixed only after the stay's records carry a returned-payment fee for every returned payment on the stay.

The advance is not worked out until the stay carries its medication setup charge whenever the stay type includes medication administration and the physician's report is on file.

Read against the stay's records:

| What the stay's records show | Position of the advance |
|---|---|
| A returned payment on the stay with no returned-payment fee for it | Not yet fixed |
| A stay type that includes medication administration, the physician's report on file, and no medication setup charge on the stay | Not yet worked out |
| A returned-payment fee for every returned payment, and the medication setup charge wherever the stay type includes medication administration and the physician's report is on file | Neither of these two conditions stands in the way |

## What paying does

- One payment entry from the guest or family is recorded on the stay, dated today, with the instrument used and a payment reference issued for the transaction.
- The stay balance falls by the amount paid; the payer sees the payment and its reference on the stay statement.

## How it is invoked

The payment is made with the customer-side tool `pay_stay_advance_b4214d09`. The agent unlocks the tool and hands it over; the customer themselves — the guest or the guest's financial representative — runs it to pay.

## Parameters

| Parameter | What it is | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `respite_stay_id` | Reference number of the respite or trial stay being paid, as given by the agent from the stay lookup | Identifier |
| `payment_method` | Instrument the payment is made with | Exactly one of: `ach_one_time` (a one-time debit from a bank account); `check` (a personal check); `certified_check` (a certified or cashier's check); `credit_card` (a credit card); `debit_card` (a debit card); `insurer_eft` (an electronic transfer from a long-term care insurer) |
| `amount` | Amount paid in USD | Positive number with 2 decimal places, already rounded half up to the cent |

## Return

A confirmation sentence naming the new payment entry reference number, the payment reference issued, the stay reference number, the instrument, the amount in USD with 2 decimal places and the resulting stay balance. A returned entry reference number means the payment was recorded.
